ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $AB=AC$, and D is the midpoint of BC. If $\angle BAC=50^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle BAD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $AB=AC$, and point $D$ is the midpoint of $BC$, $\angle BAC=50^\circ$,

$\therefore AD$ is the angle bisector of $\angle BAC$,

$\therefore \angle BAD=\angle CAD=\frac{1}{2}\angle BAC=\boxed{25^\circ}$

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as triangle ABC with segment AD drawn from apex A to point D on base BC, splitting the top angle into angles BAD and CAD. From the text, use AB=AC, D is the midpoint of BC, and angle BAC=50°. Since D is the midpoint, BD=DC, and AD is common to triangles ABD and ACD. Therefore triangles ABD and ACD are congruent by SSS, so corresponding angles BAD and CAD are equal. Because they together form angle BAC, each is 50°/2=25°.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是三角形 ABC，A 在上方，B、C 在下方形成底边 BC；点 D 位于底边 BC 上，线段 AD 从顶点 A 连到点 D，把顶角 ∠BAC 分成 ∠BAD 和 ∠CAD。
推理：题目给出 AB=AC，D 是 BC 的中点，所以 BD=DC。又因为 AD 是两个三角形 ABD 和 ACD 的公共边，因此 AB=AC、BD=DC、AD=AD，三角形 ABD 与三角形 ACD 由 SSS 全等。全等三角形对应角相等，所以 ∠BAD=∠CAD。它们合起来是 ∠BAC=50°，因此 ∠BAD=50°÷2=25°。

method.method_draft: Read the image as an isosceles triangle with apex A, base BC, and D marked on BC with AD drawn from A to the base. From the text, AB=AC and D is the midpoint of BC, so AD is the median from the apex to the base in an isosceles triangle. Use the theorem that in an isosceles triangle, the median from the vertex angle to the base is also the angle bisector. Hence AD bisects angle BAC. With angle BAC=50°, angle BAD is half of it, 25°.
